title: Choose Your Niche
lede: Explore 25 types of business and choose who you want to help.
body:
A niche is the type of customer you serve

“Plumbing businesses” is a niche. “AI receptionist” is a service. Your offer connects the two: answering missed calls for plumbing businesses so they can book more jobs.

Below are 25 niches to explore, with several services and an example problem you could investigate for each. Most services can work across several niches, and one niche can buy several services. These suggestions are not limits. Choose based on what the business needs and can gain from it, not the industry label alone.

Two ways to start

You already like a service: look for a niche where that service solves a valuable problem. Compare how other agencies serve those businesses and whether there is a gap in the location, customer type or service they provide.

You already know a niche: start there. For a custom automation agency, speak to owners about how their business works before deciding what to build. An AI audit is a conversation where you find useful improvements, then recommend and quote the specific project.

What makes a niche a good fit?

Look for businesses that can gain enough from the result to pay for your service. A business selling valuable jobs, or handling lots of customers, may have more to gain from a small improvement.

Your knowledge of the industry also helps. Do you understand the work? Can you explain the problem in their language? Is there a clear reason they would want it fixed?

Fewer competing providers can create an opening, but it only matters if customers want the service. Choose the service and niche together, then check the problem with real businesses. Staff count alone does not tell you what a business can afford.

Trades and home services

Plumbers

Services that could fit: AI receptionist, website, old-lead follow-up or custom CRM.
One problem to explore: After-hours enquiries when the team cannot answer.

Electricians

Services that could fit: AI receptionist, website, quote follow-up or custom automation.
One problem to explore: New customer calls missed while working on site.

Roofers

Services that could fit: Unsold-quote recovery, AI receptionist, website or custom CRM.
One problem to explore: Estimates sent to homeowners who have not decided.

HVAC companies

Services that could fit: Customer reactivation, AI receptionist, enquiry follow-up or custom CRM.
One problem to explore: Previous customers who may need another service or maintenance visit.

Landscapers

Services that could fit: Website, AI receptionist, quote follow-up or content engine.
One problem to explore: Customers need to see past work and request a quote.

Clinics and appointment businesses

Dental clinics

Services that could fit: AI receptionist, enquiry follow-up, customer reactivation or website.
One problem to explore: Treatment enquiries that do not reach a consultation.

Physiotherapy clinics

Services that could fit: AI receptionist, enquiry follow-up, customer reactivation or website.
One problem to explore: Patients trying to book while reception is busy.

Veterinary practices

Services that could fit: AI receptionist, website or custom admin automation.
One problem to explore: Routine booking calls that interrupt the front desk; urgent cases need a human.

Med spas

Services that could fit: Enquiry follow-up, AI receptionist, content engine or website.
One problem to explore: People asking about treatments but not booking a consultation.

Gyms and fitness studios

Services that could fit: Old-lead recovery, enquiry follow-up, content engine or website.
One problem to explore: People who enquired about joining but never started.

Property and construction

Real estate agencies

Services that could fit: Content engine, enquiry follow-up, AI receptionist or custom CRM.
One problem to explore: Agents with property footage but too little time to edit it.

Property managers

Services that could fit: AI receptionist, custom CRM, website or maintenance-request automation.
One problem to explore: Maintenance requests copied between inboxes and job systems.

Residential builders

Services that could fit: Custom CRM, quote follow-up, website or AI receptionist.
One problem to explore: Quotes, jobs and updates spread across different tools.

Renovation companies

Services that could fit: Quote recovery, AI receptionist, website or content engine.
One problem to explore: Customers with outstanding renovation proposals.

Commercial cleaners

Services that could fit: Outbound appointment setting, website, AI receptionist or custom CRM.
One problem to explore: Finding and starting conversations with businesses needing a cleaning provider.

Professional and B2B services

Recruitment agencies

Services that could fit: Outbound appointment setting, custom CRM, content engine or custom automation.
One problem to explore: Repeated candidate and client admin across several systems.

Accounting firms

Services that could fit: Document automation, AI receptionist, website or content engine.
One problem to explore: Chasing client documents and tracking what is still missing.

Law firms

Services that could fit: AI receptionist, enquiry follow-up, website or custom intake automation.
One problem to explore: New enquiries that need details collected and routing to the right person.

IT service providers

Services that could fit: Outbound appointment setting, custom CRM, website or content engine.
One problem to explore: Finding businesses suited to their support service.

Training providers

Services that could fit: Enquiry follow-up, custom CRM, website or admin automation.
One problem to explore: Enquiries, enrolments and learner records handled in separate places.

Other service businesses

Auto repair shops

Services that could fit: AI receptionist, customer reactivation, website or enquiry follow-up.
One problem to explore: Booking requests while the team is in the workshop.

Pest control companies

Services that could fit: AI receptionist, website, customer reactivation or enquiry follow-up.
One problem to explore: Customers need clear service information and an easy quote request.

Pet groomers

Services that could fit: AI receptionist, website, customer reactivation or content engine.
One problem to explore: Booking calls missed while handling animals.

Coaches and consultants

Services that could fit: Content engine, enquiry follow-up, website or custom CRM.
One problem to explore: Long videos that could become a regular supply of short clips.

Wedding and event venues

Services that could fit: Enquiry follow-up, AI receptionist, content engine or website.
One problem to explore: People asking about dates and packages but not booking a viewing.

Choose one service and one niche

You do not need to be certain forever. Choose one combination to investigate so Jarvis can research something specific.

Use the offer menu skill to help me choose one service and niche. Ask about my experience, interests, location and any service I already like. Compare up to three options and help me choose one.

When you have chosen, continue to the finished offer example. Then you will build yours step by step.
